theorems.name: Submission.dgce_graph_contDiffOn_left_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) (ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ ∃ L : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n, ∀ v, L (z + ι v + ι' (u v) - z) = v
